internal_note: Maintain strategy: wait for own receipt cost reveal before making claim. Claim exactly own receipt cost (2-8) to maximize payoff. Approve A's claim only if it matches A's receipt cost to avoid paying more than A's actual cost. Since A's receipt cost is unknown at claim time, set initial approval conservatively (e.g., 0) and update after A's cost is revealed. Monitor A's claim carefully to detect any overclaiming. This approach ensures compliance with reimbursement rule and maximizes personal payoff by avoiding overpayments or underclaims.
